svg.title: Присед с пятками на блинах — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Bodyweight squat with heels elevated on TWO separate flat round weight plates placed flat on floor, one plate beneath each heel. Front three-quarter view enough side angle to see the plate thickness, BOTH heels on plates and BOTH forefeet down on floor outside the plates. Left: standing tall. Right: lower into a squat with hips and knees bent and arms forward for balance. Same fixed plates and foot position. Empty hands; no barbell, dumbbell, shoes with raised heels, platforms or wedge. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
